name: Caribbean Community Resilience Fund
notes: Regional climate and resilience facility. Verify the umbrella structure and the separate equity and debt sleeves, their investors and commitment stages.
evidenceNote: Names Sygnus Capital as fund manager and documents IDB Invest’s equity sleeve commitment. The debt sleeve has its own disclosures.

name: Credit Risk Abatement Facility
notes: Regional energy risk-sharing facility. Verify the guarantee terms and legal roles of the CARICOM Development Fund and local lenders.
sourceTitle: Renwick & Company Becomes First Saint Lucian Business to Access CRAF Guarantee for Clean Energy
evidenceNote: Documents a guarantee for a Saint Lucian business under CDF’s clean-energy risk-sharing mechanism.

name: Caribbean Biodiversity Fund Endowment Fund
notes: Biodiversity and conservation finance. Distinguish the umbrella organization, endowment and individual national conservation trust funds.
evidenceNote: Describes endowment investment and downstream support for eligible national conservation trust funds.

name: Caribbean Biodiversity Fund Ecosystem-based Adaptation Facility
notes: Regional conservation and adaptation finance. Verify grant cycles, facility structure and beneficiary organizations.
evidenceNote: Identifies awards through the Ecosystem-based Adaptation Facility and distinguishes them from the endowment programme.

name: Barbados Blue Loan for Marine Conservation
notes: Blue finance. Map the debt conversion, guarantee structure and conservation fund as distinct records when verified. Track the term loan as a historical financing mechanism.
sourceTitle: Barbados Places Climate Financing Firmly on Agenda with IDB, Nature Conservancy Support
evidenceNote: Identifies the completed debt conversion, blue loan and conservation use of savings. Names distinct arrangers and guarantors.

name: Jamaica Catastrophe Bond (2026)
notes: Sovereign disaster-risk finance. Verify the covered period, trigger and settlement terms. Link predecessor coverage as a separate historical mechanism.
sourceTitle: World Bank Prices Catastrophe Bond Providing Protection for Jamaica Replacing Coverage Triggered by Hurricane Melissa
evidenceNote: Documents an IBRD-issued catastrophe bond backing parametric cyclone coverage for Jamaica.

name: Barbados Energy Smart Fund II
notes: Domestic green financing. Confirm the role of the fund administrator, current instrument windows and sources of capitalization.
sourceTitle: Sustainable Energy Investment Programme (Energy Smart Fund 2)
sourcePublisher: Government of Barbados, Ministry of Energy and Business
evidenceNote: Identifies a financing programme to increase renewable energy and energy efficiency and reduce fossil fuel dependency in Barbados.

name: MPC Caribbean Clean Energy Fund
notes: Renewable energy infrastructure vehicle. Resolve the relationships among the fund, listed feeder or holding vehicle and investment manager. Date portfolio evidence because assets have changed hands.
evidenceNote: Names Paradise Park in Jamaica as the fund’s first investment.

name: MPC Capital
notes: Private energy investment manager. Confirm the responsible legal entity, its role in the Caribbean vehicle and current holdings after the Jamaica exit.
sourceTitle: MPC Capital successfully sells Jamaica’s largest solar power plant
evidenceNote: Documents the firm’s role and the exit from Paradise Park in Jamaica.

name: Supporting Resilient Green Energy (SuRGE) Programme
notes: Regional energy transition facility. Verify the Canadian financing role, CDB administration and allocation of concessional resources.
sourceTitle: CDB Marks Major Milestone with Financial Close on Dominica Geothermal Energy Project
evidenceNote: Links a financial close in Dominica to SuRGE and identifies Canada’s regional programme.

name: Green Climate Fund Project Preparation Facility
notes: International project preparation facility. Check which Caribbean applications advanced to approval and which became funded activities.
sourceTitle: Transforming Finance to Unlock Climate Action in the Caribbean
evidenceNote: Documents a PPF request from CDB for proposal preparation involving Belize, Jamaica and Saint Lucia.

name: CDB Climate Change Project Preparation Fund
notes: Regional project preparation facility. Confirm sponsor and administrator roles, eligible preparation activities and approved country support.
evidenceNote: Describes the preparation fund and eligible climate activities for CDB borrowing member countries.

name: Global Biodiversity Framework Fund
notes: International environmental fund. Distinguish the GBFF from the general GEF Trust Fund and verify the agencies and counterparties for individual Caribbean operations.
sourceTitle: Support for the development of a national policy, institutional and monitoring framework to effectively implement the Nagoya Protocol in Belize
evidenceNote: Identifies the Global Biodiversity Framework Fund as the source for an approved operation in Belize.

name: Special Climate Change Fund
notes: International adaptation fund. Verify the participating Caribbean governments, delivery agency and instrument status for the fisheries operation.
sourceTitle: Climate Change Resilience in the Caribbean Fisheries Sector (CC4FISH-II)
evidenceNote: Identifies the SCCF as the source for an approved Caribbean fisheries adaptation operation.

name: BRIDGE Green Transition Grant
notes: Regional enterprise green financing. Confirm award records and the link, if any, between this grant window and broader EU enterprise financing.
sourceTitle: Green Transition – Building Resilient Innovation for Digital & Green Enterprises
evidenceNote: Identifies an EU-funded grant window for environmental improvements by Caribbean MSMEs.

name: FMO (Dutch Entrepreneurial Development Bank)
notes: Public development finance institution participating in private-sector energy finance. Verify the signed individual instrument and legal counterparty on the Enertur facility.
evidenceNote: Identifies Enertur and the renewable power and battery investment in the Dominican Republic.

name: Caribbean Strategic Advisors
notes: Candidate from the project brief. Confirm the legal identity, official website and investment activities before proposing a registry entry.

name: NRStor Caribbean
notes: Candidate from the project brief. Confirm the operating entity and the distinction between the company and any individual energy projects.
